question: Ticket 380d524e6e9c says 'bin/cairn (the bash launcher, unchanged) on Linux; only Windows gets Python implementation in bin/cairn.py', but outline 5.4.3.8 reads "The launcher is Python (bin/cairn), run by Cairn's own interpreter, so Windows needs no bash. Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
